1.say: The file covers 1988 to 1996 and then begins again in 1999. What happened in the missing three years? The file does not say. That is your finding. A text is also what it leaves out, and that gap is the most interesting thing on the page. It could be an accident. It could. Now look at who wrote the part that survives. The same office that would have been blamed. So you have two facts: the gap, and who kept the file. Neither one proves anything. Together they tell you how to read everything else in it. Do I write that? You write both facts and you let the reader draw it. Draw it for them and be wrong, and you have lost the facts as well. Sarah says the first question is always who is telling me this. And the second is what they wanted on the day they wrote it down. Very few documents were written for you.

grammar.label: reading a text for what it does not say
grammar.form: the absent qualification; the unanswered question; the missing comparison
grammar.meaning: finds the argument by noticing what a careful writer has left out

explanation.en: A prospectus that gives three-year figures for a five-year-old company has told you something. The reading skill is to hold the shape a complete account would have, and notice where this one differs. It is not suspicion; it is knowing what a full version looks like.
explanation.uz: Besh yillik kompaniya haqida uch yillik raqam bergan hujjat sizga nimadir aytdi. Mahorat — to'liq bayon qanday bo'lishini bilish va farqni sezish.

grammar.positive_example: The figures run from 2021; the company was founded in 2019, and nothing explains the gap.
grammar.negative_example: The figures run from 2021 and show steady growth over the period covered.

l1_notes.uz: Yo'q narsani sezish — tanqidiy o'qishning eng qiyin qismi.

grammar.label: provenance — reading a text for who wrote it and why
grammar.form: commissioning body, funder, intended reader, date, what the writer stood to gain
grammar.meaning: places a text in the circumstances that produced it

explanation.en: The same sentence means different things in a company report and in a regulator's finding. At C2 the reading begins before the first line: who paid, who was meant to read it, what could not be said in that document. This is not cynicism — a text with excellent provenance is more trustworthy, and you can only know that by asking.
explanation.uz: Bir xil jumla kompaniya hisobotida va nazorat organining xulosasida turli ma'no tashiydi. O'qish birinchi satrdan oldin boshlanadi: kim to'lagan, kim uchun yozilgan.

grammar.positive_example: The review is independent of the company and was commissioned by the regulator.
grammar.negative_example: The review is independent, as it says on its own first page.

l1_notes.uz: Matn kelib chiqishini so'rash — akademik va jurnalistik ko'nikma, madaniy emas.

body.speaker: Dilnoza
body.text: The file covers 1988 to 1996 and then begins again in 1999.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: What happened in the missing three years?

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: That is your finding. A text is also what it leaves out, and that gap is the most interesting thing on the page.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: It could. Now look at who wrote the part that survives.

body.speaker: Dilnoza
body.text: The same office that would have been blamed.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: So you have two facts: the gap, and who kept the file. Neither one proves anything. Together they tell you how to read everything else in it.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: You write both facts and you let the reader draw it. Draw it for them and be wrong, and you have lost the facts as well.

body.speaker: Dilnoza
body.text: Sarah says the first question is always who is telling me this.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: And the second is what they wanted on the day they wrote it down. Very few documents were written for you.
